newsitem.title: USA: Asbury takes majority stake in David McDavid Auto.
newsitem.headline: Asbury takes majority stake in David McDavid Auto.

text.p: Privately-held Asbury Automotive Group said Monday it agreed to take a majority stake in private David McDavid Auto Group.
David McDavid of Dallas operates 14 new car dealerships in Texas, and has more than $500 million in annual revenues, a company statement said.

Asbury, which is controlled by private investment firms Ripplewood Holdings and Freeman Spogli & Co, did not disclose the terms of the deal. A spokesman said the company usually takes a 51 percent to 80 percent stake in similar deals.
Asbury owns a majority interest in Nalley Cos of Atlanta, which owns 11 dealerships. It recently agreed to buy a majority interest in Plaza Motors of St Louis.
